avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Curcumin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance T-cell activation and increase risk of immune-related adverse events (irAEs)
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; inform oncology team of use

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates immune stimulation, potentially amplifying checkpoint inhibitor effects and irAEs

avoid_supplements.name: Medicinal Mushrooms (Reishi, Cordyceps, Maitake)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune-stimulating polysaccharides may exacerbate T-cell activation and irAEs
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid during active treatment; discuss with oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate gut microbiota composition, which influences checkpoint inhibitor efficacy; individual response varies
caution_supplements.action: Monitor tolerance; coordinate with healthcare team; certain strains may be beneficial

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Anti-inflammatory effects may theoretically reduce irAE severity, but high doses could interfere with immune activation
caution_supplements.action: Use moderate doses; monitor for bleeding risk if combined with anticoagulants

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Immunomodulatory; deficiency associated with worse outcomes in cancer immunotherapy, but excess may enhance irAEs
caution_supplements.action: Maintain adequate levels (25-50 ng/mL); avoid megadoses; monitor serum levels

avoid_foods.name: Charred/Heavily Grilled Meats
avoid_foods.mechanism: Heterocyclic amines (HCAs) and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) may increase systemic inflammation and irAE risk
avoid_foods.action: Minimize consumption; prefer gentle cooking methods

caution_foods.name: Fermented Foods (Sauerkraut, Kimchi, Miso)
caution_foods.mechanism: May modify gut microbiota composition, which influences immunotherapy response; effects are individualized
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; moderate intake acceptable; consistency may matter more than avoidance

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive dietary fat may promote pro-inflammatory immune responses and increase irAE risk
caution_foods.action: Maintain balanced diet; limit saturated fats; focus on Mediterranean-style nutrition

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (Broccoli, Cabbage, Brussels Sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Glucosinolates may modulate immune function; generally beneficial but individual tolerance varies
caution_foods.action: Continue consumption; beneficial antioxidant properties; monitor GI tolerance

monitoring_notes: Pembrolizumab is not hepatically metabolized, minimizing direct drug-metabolism interactions; however, supplements and foods that modulate immune function or increase inflammation warrant careful consideration to minimize immune-related adverse events. Maintain open communication with oncology team regarding all supplements and dietary modifications; microbiota composition may significantly influence immunotherapy efficacy.
